summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the rulings add up to, and which reviewers' evidence fell short.

items.description: One item per distinct claim, duplicates merged, sorted by severity, highest first.

severity.description: The highest severity among the sources.

reason.description: Why the presented evidence does or does not support the claim.

action.description: fix: the change the evidence calls for, as the reviewer stated it. defer: gap, trigger, done when. owner: the question and its options. reject: empty.

missing_evidence.description: reject: what the reviewer should have shown. Otherwise empty.
